t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The goal is to gather as many mushrooms as possible. Mushrooms are points, but the points are also sometimes multiplied. Choosing between gnomes leads you to different forests to gather mushrooms. The colour of the gnomes is the important thing to notice. The gnomes other features such as hats are not important for finding mushrooms. The gnomes appear in the same pairs, but the positions of the gnomes will change. Some coloured gnomes will send you to a bright forest while the others will send you to a dark forest. The colour of the basket will change from yellow to red depending on the the forest.

vb_textbox.text: The goal is to collect as many mushrooms as possible. 1 mushroom is 1 point, but there are also points multipliers. There are two different forests in which to collect mushrooms. One has a red basket and the other a yellow one. The profitability of each forest will vary with time.  The gnomes always come in the same pairs. Blue with purple, green with pink, red with yellow, and brown with orange. The blue, green, red, and orange gnomes will lead you to the forest with the red basket. The purple, pink, yellow, and brown gnomes will lead you to the forest with the yellow basket. Decide which forest is more profitable at that time and choose the corresponding gnome of the pair. The gnomes other features such as size and hat types are irrelevant. Only the colour tells you what forest they will lead you to.
